name: search_wiki
description: Search across all crawled wiki pages using RAG semantic search to find relevant information. Use this when you need clarification or additional context about a character, event, or relationship from pages you haven't processed yet. Returns relevant text excerpts with source URLs.

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g., 'Who is Gyatso?', 'What happened to Aang's parents?')

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5, max: 10)
